children: DPC Holdings completed a refinancing anchored by a new $325 million unsecured, multi-currency revolving credit facility led by Barclays Bank as administrative agent. The five-year facility includes a $150 million uncommitted accordion, a $50 million swingline, and a $50 million letter of credit sub-facility, and allows USD, EUR, and GBP borrowings. In connection with the new agreement, the company repaid in full and terminated its senior secured term note loan and its asset-backed lending facility with Wells Fargo. A concurrent Guarantee Agreement by DPC Holdings and certain subsidiaries supports obligations under the new revolver, enhancing liquidity and financial flexibility.
